title: 12/08/2023 - Software Updates
content:
## 12/08/2023 - Software Updates


Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000097541

We made updates to several Default Widgets this week. If you have customized any of these widgets and would like to update your customized widget, you can find the latest code in the corresponding Default Widget. Please remember that if you have a custom version of any of these widgets, our latest updates have not been pushed to your website.

- We fixed an issue which was preventing the "Print" button on Multi-Photo Post Type detail pages from displaying the images properly in the print layout in some cases. Widgets Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Display - Print Button Bootstrap Theme - Photo Album Page

- We created a new text label for the "Overall Rating" column heading when viewing member reviews in the Member Dashboard. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Account - Reviews Datatable Text Label Involved: rating_criteria_overall_th

- We fixed an issue which was affecting the abilty to pass a coupon code as part of the checkout URL using the "refcode" URL variable in some cases. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Function - Order Summary

- We updated the Froala WYSIWYGs on the frontend of sites to add the "Replace" image feature when updating images inside the content editor.

- We updated the Private Member Chat Add-On to automatically scroll to the most recent messages at the bottom of the chat when viewing messages in the Member Dashboard.

- We fixed an issue which was preventing the "Use same language for text labels" General Setting from working properly after selecting a new Default Website Language in some cases.

- We updated the "Upload Photos" tab when adding photos to a Multi-Image post in order to hide the "Move To" dropdown if there are no other posts available of the same post type. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Account - Edit Uploaded Photos

- We fixed an issue which was preventing members from deleting posts from the Member Dashboard when the Post Type name contained an apostrophe in some cases. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Account - Feature Body datatable Bootstrap Theme - Account - Photo Albums datatable

- We fixed an issue which preventing the "Show Widgets" feature in the Admin Sidebar from working properly on Multi-Photo Post Types detail pages when viewing the frontend of a site as an Admin in some cases.

- We fixed an issue which was preventing the Hero Title and Sub-Title from respecting their corresponding alignment settings in some cases. Widgets Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Homepage Search - Hero Message with Button Links Bootstrap Theme - Homepage Search - Hero Message with Link

- We fixed an issue which was preventing the "Featured Blog Article Slider" widget from respecting the "Font Color" selected on the Design Settings page in the Admin in some cases. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Custom Appearance Settings

- We created a new Design Setting for the "Featured Blog Article Slider" widget called "Hide on Mobile?". When this setting is active, the system will hide the corresponding widget module on the homepage when viewed from a mobile device. To use this new feature navigate to the Admin >> Settings >> Design Settings >> Homepage tab >> Select Content to Display.

- We fixed an issue which was causing the system to add default Brilliant Directories CSS classes to elements inside <iframe> elements in some cases. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme Framework

- We updated the "Member Profile URL Structure" Advanced Setting in order to include the Country Short Name (country_short_name) and State Short Name (state_short_name) as options to use with the setting.

- We fixed an issue which was causing the system to change some of the text inside the Profile Photo tab in the Member Dashboard when the site has activated a Member Dashboard Webhook in some cases.

- We implemented an update in order to respect the Default Website Language setting when sending emails from the Admin.
